messages:
Maya Chen: opened a docs PR to standardize audit webhook examples and retention language. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/854
Maya Chen: main changes: remove PII from examples, show pseudonymization pattern, add CLI export + redaction example, and add deprecation guidance for the old audit_event field. Need legal wording check before merge.
Priya Shah: paste the example you plan to include? want to make sure SOC2 reviewers see no raw emails/phones.
Maya Chen: example payload I propose:
```json
{
  "event_type": "session.start",
  "tenant": "t-9012",
  "time": "2026-02-18T09:12:34Z",
  "actor": { "role": "user", "id": "usr-aaaa" },
  "meta": { "pseudonym_id": "pid-xxxxx", "location": "[redacted]" }
}
```
Notes: using pseudonym_id, location redacted, and shortened field names to avoid accidental leakage in examples.
Samir Patel: SDK change checklist: Ruby and JS examples will need minimal edits (event_type -> event_type, parse pseudonym_id). I'll add a short migration snippet to the PR showing both old and new keys with a compatibility wrapper.
Priya Shah: retention wording question 1 0: SOC2 team liked specific TTLs. Legal usually wants "configurable" + legal hold mention. Suggest phrasing: "Default audit event retention is 90 days; configurable per contract. Legal holds will preserve events until released." Thoughts?
Legal - Compliance: That phrasing is fine. Add an explicit sentence: "Customers seeking extended retention must contact sales for contract amendments." And: avoid promises of "indefinite" storage. Also request we link to the evidence playbook and to export APIs.
Docs Bot: linkcheck: the evidence playbook link in the new section points to /docs/evidence-playbook and is 404 on staging.
Maya Chen: I'll fix the link target to /evidence-playbook-v1 and include the export API example. Also will add a short note about legal hold precedence over TTLs.
Samir Patel: adding migration helper example in JS:
```js
// compatibility helper
function getEvent(payload){
  return payload.event_type || payload.audit_event;
}
```
Add deprecation header guidance: send X-Deprecation-Warn when payload contains audit_event.
Priya Shah: please also add a one-paragraph FAQ: "What if my integration sends emails/phones?" -> answer: "Do not send raw PII; use pseudonymization or tokens; contact support for migration help."
Legal - Compliance: approve for wording once the evidence-playbook link is fixed and the export sample shows redaction flags.
Maya Chen: planning to include curl export example with redact flag per Elena's suggestion earlier:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/export?since=2026-01-01" \
  -o export.json \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{ "redact_keys": ["email","phone","ip"], "format": "jsonl" }
JSON
```
Exported sample in docs will show ip/location as "[redacted]".
Docs Bot: Reminder: after merge run `npm run linkcheck` and add PR # to release notes.
Maya Chen: thanks all, I'll push fixes in ~30m and tag @Legal - Compliance and @Samir for a final read. :party:
